_about: Reviewed against untouched Chinese v4.0.3 scripts and existing emulator-backed quest audits, 2026-10-09. Key: trade + file. No starter gate on ordinary trades; loan/replacement records 6 and 8 have explicit route conditions. Map access is still subject to story progression.

conditions: Defeat the Raticate Gentleman on the S.S. Anne, then trade him a Butterfree during the ship visit.
evidence: CN script156 entry31 @1816 tests win flag1516; battle156 @1834 sets1516 @1866; trade0 @4969, sets1515 @5007.

conditions: First trade Butterfree for the Gentleman’s Raticate on the S.S. Anne; then trade a Raticate back in the 1F northwest rooms.
evidence: CN script161 entry24 @887 requires flag1515, trade1 @969 clears1515 @1007.

conditions: Trade a Budew when Goldenrod is not under Team Rocket occupation.
One trade per game.
evidence: CN script884 entry3 @74 requires flag441 set; @85 rejects completed flag1616; trade2 @168. Flag441 hides Goldenrod takeover crowd (guide/known-issues.md Goldenrod overcrowding).

conditions: Trade a Goldeen to the fisherman beside Ecruteak’s pond.
One trade per game.
evidence: CN script916 entry8 @508 rejects completed flag138; trade3 @592.

conditions: In the souvenir shop annex (east door), answer “Insomnia Pokémon”, then “Hoothoot”, and trade a Hoothoot.
One trade per game; wrong answers can be retried.
evidence: CN script88 entry2 @86 needs flag509 set; menu Insomnia @165→985; Hoothoot @1040→1326; trade4 @1552 clears509 @1597. Annex NPC object14 has no hide flag.

conditions: Trade a Bagon in the Resort Zone.
One trade per game.
evidence: CN script116 entry27 @939 rejects completed flag2132; trade5 @1021.

conditions: Pikachu starter only.
Lend your own Pidgeot after the Volcano Badge but before the Earth Badge or becoming Champion; keep at least one other Pokémon.
After entering the Hall of Fame, return with a free party slot to receive a fixed Lv. 20 replacement Pidgeot.
The original Pidgeot is not returned: its level, moves, EVs and held item are lost.
evidence: CN script115 @2225, @4827, @5794–5824; GiveLoanMon [6,20,75] @5818; return requires game-clear flag2404.
guide/01-pallet-to-pewter.md: Viridian Forest lend her a Pidgeot; emulator evidence D-1392/D-1552 confirms replacement rather than restoration.

All four ReturnLoanMon call sites scanned: file115 takes Pidgeot, file240 takes Jigglypuff, file842 takes a quest Pokémon, file913 takes Tentacool; none takes Gyarados. Bank0547#106 explicitly lets the player keep Gyarados.
entries.label: Replacement for lent Pidgeot

conditions: Male player with Bulbasaur starter only.
Misty offers this Lv. 20 Gyarados during the Celadon gatehouse rescue, after her Starmie is wounded.
Have a free party slot; if your party is full, speak to Misty again. She lets you keep it at the end of the Celadon story.
evidence: CN script172 entry28 @2415 requires starter flag1289 (Bulbasaur); @2426–2436 requires male; @2443 rejects flag1081; GiveLoanMon [8,20,101] @2481 / @11020.
